Let \(G=X=\mathbb F_2^8/\langle \mathbf 1\rangle\). This is an abelian group of order \(128\). Since the kernel
\[
K(u,v)=d(u,v)^p
\]
is translation-invariant, the negative-type condition on the zero-sum subspace is equivalent to requiring every nontrivial Fourier eigenvalue of \(g\mapsto d(0,g)^p\) to be \(\le 0\).

Characters of \(G\) correspond to vectors \(a\in\mathbb F_2^8\) of even Hamming weight. The eigenvalue depends only on \(m=\operatorname{wt}(a)\in\{0,2,4,6,8\}\). For nontrivial characters, \(m=2,4,6,8\). Using
\[
\lambda_m=\frac12\sum_{z\in\mathbb F_2^8}\min(\operatorname{wt}z,8-\operatorname{wt}z)^p(-1)^{a\cdot z},
\]
the needed Krawtchouk values for \(j=1,2,3,4\) are
\[
\begin{array}{c|rrrr}
m & j=1&j=2&j=3&j=4\\ \hline
2&4&4&-4&-10\\
4&0&-4&0&6\\
6&-4&4&4&-10\\
8&-8&28&-56&70
\end{array}
\]
so
\[
\begin{aligned}
\lambda_2&=4+4\,2^p-4\,3^p-5\,4^p,\\
\lambda_4&=-4\,2^p+3\,4^p,\\
\lambda_6&=-4+4\,2^p+4\,3^p-5\,4^p,\\
\lambda_8&=-8+28\,2^p-56\,3^p+35\,4^p.
\end{aligned}
\]

The first eigenvalue to vanish is \(\lambda_8\). Let \(\rho\) be the unique positive root of
\[
35\,4^\rho-56\,3^\rho+28\,2^\rho-8=0.
\]
Numerically,
\[
\rho=0.13537272355672772\ldots
\]
On \(0<p\le \rho\), one has \(\lambda_2,\lambda_4,\lambda_6<0\) and \(\lambda_8\le0\). For \(p>\rho\), either \(\lambda_8>0\) before \(\log_2(4/3)\), or \(\lambda_4>0\) after that point, so negative type fails. Hence
\[
\wp=\rho.
\]

At \(p=\wp\), the only zero nontrivial eigenspace is the \(m=8\) Fourier layer, which has multiplicity \(\binom88=1\). Therefore
\[
\dim E=1.
\]

\[
\boxed{\left(\rho,1\right)}
\]
where \(\rho\) is the unique positive solution of
\[
35\,4^\rho-56\,3^\rho+28\,2^\rho-8=0.
\]
